release_notes: Hotfix for v1.5.9: every incoming postback answered 500 on PHP 8.1-8.3 (which is what Ubuntu 22.04 / Debian 12 / Ubuntu 24.04 install), because the new conversion transaction is opened with a raw BEGIN IMMEDIATE that PDO::SQLite before 8.4 cannot see through inTransaction() (php bug #81227) - the rollback guards rejected every write and networks retried each second. A new orbitraPostbackTransactionActive() helper asks SQLite itself on older PHP (BEGIN DEFERRED probe) and keeps using inTransaction() on 8.4+; the automatic-rollback guards in the CAPI/attribution writers use it too, restoring their protection on old PHP. The installer now provisions a current PHP (8.5, fallback 8.4) from ondrej/php or packages.sury.org with a distro fallback and a PHP 8.1+ hard check, and the in-panel update warns with an upgrade path when the server still runs PHP below 8.4. Queue worker health timestamps are now written in UTC (a dead cron no longer looks alive for hours on non-UTC servers) and the S2S log shows next_retry_at in the panel timezone. Update immediately if you installed v1.5.9: postbacks whose senders do not retry are being lost on PHP below 8.4.
